text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I drop by the infirmary to
find...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Yawn...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh? Did I... fall asleep?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Wait, it's this late?! Wh-what's going on here?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, you fell asleep shortly after taking
the
tablet I prescribed.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Although, you woke up earlier than I
expected...
Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No matter. Your skin, posture, the glint
in your eyes—everything appears to be
in excellent
condition. The experiment
was a success!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
E-experiment? But I thought I took a
new type of
supplement...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And indeed you did. A brand new
innovation from
the mind of yours truly.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's the ultimate supplement! The more
fatigued you are at the time of
ingestion, the more restful
of a sleep
you will have!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You're my first non-rodent subject. And 
considering the evidence,
I'd say this is a
huge
success.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
But why?! I've still got so much to do
today...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's far too obvious you've been
overexerting
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ack! Well...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: B-but I need to try harder!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, slow down. I heard something
most
intriguing the other day.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Regardless of your path, all athletes are
fighting an uphill battle with their
physical limits, trying to
reach the top of
their own mountain.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Comparing training to climbing a
mountain is
rather ingenious, I'd say.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The peak you aim for, the course you
choose, the tools you use and people
you climb with... Timing the trek based
on your condition and
environment...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You could prepare everything perfectly,
but what do you think would happen if
you tried to climb
the whole mountain
without breaks?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well... that's just an accident waiting to
happen, I
guess.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, thus proving that thorough rest
leads to
prime bodybuilding!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Thorough rest, huh? If you say so,
Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'll take care to start taking rest more
seriously
from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Excellent. Now that's settled, we're
ready to move
things along to the next
phase.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Next... phase?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Let's say the supplement I first
prescribed you is called "Tablet A".
What I'm about to inject into
you now
is... "Solution B".

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
With the lingering remnants of Tablet A
in your
body as a catalyst, you should in
theory feel even
more refreshed!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
No, nope, out of the question! I'm done
with that!
I've had plenty of rest!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about? If I don't
inject you
with the solution, the Tablet
A compounds in your
body will explode!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Seriously?! Y-y-you're joking, right?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it was merely a jest. A necessary act
to draw
your attention.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I've already injected you with the
solution.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm really... getting... slee...py...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...In fact, all I did was give your arm a
slight poke
with my fingernail.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Sweet dreams, Scarlet. Rest well.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Considering you were fatigued enough
to fall into
slumber from a mere placebo,
I'd say you need it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm? You there—would you care for a
moment of
respite?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I run off in a mad panic.
